title: AI Agent for Your Lendersa Database: Retrieve, Update and Manage

sections.label: 1 - AN AI AGENT ON YOUR EXISTING DATABASE
sections.note: You ask your Lendersa database a question in plain English. Claude reads your lenders, loan programs and borrower requests and answers from the real rows, never from memory.

sections.label: 2 - RETRIEVE, UPDATE AND MANAGE: UPDATES WAIT FOR YOUR YES
sections.note: Your parts 2 and 3: retrieving and updating in one smooth chat. A change is shown back to you as old value and new value first, and only a yes moves it forward.

sections.label: 3 - INTEGRATED WITH YOUR CURRENT DATABASE
sections.note: The approved change is written to your own Postgres, inside one transaction, only to the tables and columns you allowed. Every change lands in a change log you can undo from.

sections.label: 4 - RELIABLE PERFORMANCE: IF ANYTHING FAILS, YOU HEAR ABOUT IT
sections.note: A failed query or a timeout never fails quietly. You get an email with the step, the error and a link to the run.

nodes.label: 1 - You Ask Your Lendersa Database in Plain English
2 - Claude Finds Lenders, Loan Programs and Borrower Requests
nodes.notes: Answers come from your rows, with the IDs, so you can check any answer.

params.system_message: You are the database assistant for Lendersa, a marketplace that matches borrowers with lenders. The Postgres database has three main tables: lenders (lender_id, name, type, states_served, status), loan_programs (program_id, lender_id, program_name, loan_type, max_ltv, min_loan, max_loan, updated_at) and borrower_requests (request_id, loan_type, property_state, property_city, loan_amount, ltv, status). Always answer from the search tool, never from memory, and include the IDs of the rows you used. If a search returns nothing, say so and suggest one looser search (a nearby state, a wider loan range). Loan amounts are in US dollars and LTV is a percentage. When the user asks to change, add or archive anything, call the stage-update tool with the table, the row ID, the column, the current value and the new value, then show the user the old value and the new value and ask them to reply yes. Only the tables and columns listed in editable_tables can be staged; refuse anything else and say why. Never delete a row: archive it by setting status to archived. Set action to apply only when the user's latest message clearly approves the change you staged in this chat (yes, go ahead, apply it); if they change their mind or ask something else, set action to answer. If two rows could match a change (two lenders with similar names), list both and ask which one before staging.

nodes.label: Claude - Reads Your Data and Plans the Change
Memory - Keeps the Chat and the Staged Change Together
Tool - Search Lenders, Loan Programs and Borrower Requests
nodes.notes: Read-only: it runs parameterised SELECTs, so a question can never change a row.

params.description: Search the Lendersa database. Input: table (lenders, loan_programs or borrower_requests), filters as column and value pairs (for example loan_type = land, property_state = PR, max_ltv >= 55), and a limit up to 50. Runs a read-only parameterised SELECT and returns the matching rows with their IDs.

nodes.label: Tool - Stage an Update, Add or Archive for Your Yes

params.description: Stage a change without applying it. Input: table, row ID, column, current value, new value and the reason. Checks the table and column are in editable_tables, reads the live current value, writes one row to agent_pending_changes with status pending and this chat's session ID, and returns the change_id with the old and new values to show the user.

nodes.label: Parser - Reply, Action and Change ID

schema.reply: Caribe Land Capital (lender 3127), Raw Land Loan - Puerto Rico (program 8841): max LTV is 60 now, will be 55. Reply yes to apply.

nodes.label: 3 - You Said Yes to the Staged Change?
nodes.notes: The guard: Claude can suggest a change, only your yes applies it.

nodes.label: 3b - Answer You, or Show the Old and New Value to Confirm
4 - Postgres: Apply the Staged Change to Your Live Row
nodes.notes: Applies only a change staged earlier in this same chat, only to the columns you allowed.

params.query: SELECT change_id, table_name, record_id, column_name, old_value, new_value FROM apply_agent_change($1, $2);
